adds.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling November 2023 designating 'the international LGBT public movement' as extremist
adds.summary: In November 2023 the Supreme Court of Russia designated the 'international LGBT public movement' as extremist and banned its activities throughout Russia including Udmurtia, making display of LGBT symbols, advocacy, organizing, participation and support punishable as extremism with fines, administrative detention and criminal imprisonment, exposing trans visitors to detention, prosecution and imprisonment for visible gender-identity expression, association or advocacy.
